setup.title: Enable reservations
setup.lead: Reservations work for meeting rooms, vehicles, keys, … via the same unit QR.
steps: Open Locations/units and edit the category (e.g. Meeting rooms).
Turn on Reservable for that category — all units under it become bookable.
Optionally turn off Allow reservations on units you want to exclude.
Share or print the unit QR — guests will see the Reserve tile.

form.staff_hint: Reservations you create here are confirmed immediately (no 30-minute email hold).
